input.quote: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of the Fees paid or payable by Customer during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and USD 1,000,000. The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims.
input.rationale: Section 21 meets the preferred position in full: the cap is expressly mutual and set at the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000 (21.1); consequential/indirect damages are mutually excluded with helpful direct-damage carve-ins for data restoration, replacement services, notification and incident response (21.2); and the defined "Excluded Claims" in 21.3 sit outside both the cap and the exclusion, covering confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, and infringement of the other Party's IP. Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is expressly not "damages" and is not limited. The "Fees" definition (1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap base is meaningful and not illusory; the only minor point (noted, not flagged) is that Fees exclude a one-time implementation charge unless an Order Form says otherwise, which slightly narrows the fee base but is immaterial given the USD 1,000,000 floor. Section 18.2 confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, and 21.4 preserves independence of each cap and survival past failure of an exclusive remedy. No redline required.
